# MAJOR//minor website placement specification

## Page

- Title: `~4B Agent Model Benchmark`
- Description: `A deterministic comparison of approximately 3B–4B local models on reasoning, tool use, restraint, and verification behaviors for autonomous agents.`
- Category: Local AI / Agent evaluation
- Status: Completed study; publication pending review

## Presentation

Lead with a four-model score chart showing 25, 17, 14, and 12 out of 80, with a clear note that scores are bounded benchmark points rather than general intelligence. Add a compact finalist repetition panel for Ministral and Qwen3, a resource-eligibility panel, and a separate admission/exclusion table for Phi-4 Mini, Gemma 3 4B, Granite 3.3, and SmolLM3.

Methodology should summarize the ThinkPad consumer-local environment, frozen llama.cpp/Vulkan/RADV runtime, seven Q01–Q07 tasks, deterministic simulator/scorer, structured compatibility gate, and 16K context/resource rules. Do not nest this page under the paused harness study. The future harness study receives its own page.

Eventually link to the standalone repository, report/analysis, manifests, processed results, and a raw-evidence release after the public-release checklist passes.
